title: Security Hardening, Startup Reliability & Display Fix
headline: Live intelligence and debloater endpoints are now protected, startup history and diagnostics are user-scoped, telemetry startup is smoother, and malformed display metadata can no longer blank the dashboard.
changes: Protected live network diagnostics, tweak intelligence, power intelligence, dashboard intelligence, and debloater history/action endpoints with authenticated access
Scoped network benchmark baselines and debloater history to the authenticated user while preserving Electron loopback authentication
Added CSRF-safe authenticated client requests for network benchmarking and debloater actions
Hardened startup telemetry priming and heartbeat execution to reduce duplicate probes and startup overhead
Fixed the Electron startup reveal flow so the window waits for both Chromium and the first React splash frame before showing
Fixed a dashboard crash caused by malformed display connection metadata calling string methods on non-string values
Expanded Process Manager and Debloat installed-app icon coverage, fixed light-mode loading spinners and active navigation rings, and cleaned up the startup score gauge
